scope: Transparent synthetic development evaluation; not blinded
recall: macro intersection of returned IDs and required IDs / required IDs
precision_at_5: macro relevant IDs / 5 on support-bearing questions
negative_R: empty-result rate reported separately; not answer abstention
answer_components: casefolded canonical components separated by semicolon must occur in answer; no human semantic claim
grounded_components: component match AND all required citations with exact source revisions AND no out-of-scope citations; unsupported questions require empty answer and no citations
timing: written before coordinator reads/scorers consume any final answers; workers never receive grading output
